title: Puppy dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- ground shadow -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='88' rx='26' ry='5' fill='#3a2c55'/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M70 62 Q84 54 82 42 Q80 36 74 38 Q76 48 66 56 Z' fill='#c98a4b'/>
  <!-- legs with dancing pose -->
  <rect x='34' y='68' width='9' height='16' rx='4' fill='#e0a35e'/>
  <rect x='57' y='66' width='9' height='16' rx='4' fill='#e0a35e' transform='rotate(-18 61 74)'/>
  <!-- paws -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='84' rx='7' ry='4' fill='#f6d3a0'/>
  <ellipse cx='64' cy='82' rx='7' ry='4' fill='#f6d3a0'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='20' ry='17' fill='#e8b06a'/>
  <!-- belly patch -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='66' rx='12' ry='11' fill='#f7dca8'/>
  <!-- raised dancing arm -->
  <rect x='62' y='44' width='8' height='16' rx='4' fill='#e0a35e' transform='rotate(35 66 52)'/>
  <ellipse cx='78' cy='44' rx='6' ry='4.5' fill='#f6d3a0'/>
  <!-- other arm -->
  <rect x='28' y='52' width='8' height='15' rx='4' fill='#e0a35e' transform='rotate(-25 32 60)'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='48' cy='34' r='18' fill='#e8b06a'/>
  <!-- ear left -->
  <ellipse cx='32' cy='26' rx='7' ry='12' fill='#b9752f' transform='rotate(-15 32 26)'/>
  <!-- ear right -->
  <ellipse cx='64' cy='26' rx='7' ry='12' fill='#b9752f' transform='rotate(15 64 26)'/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='42' rx='11' ry='8' fill='#f7dca8'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='41' cy='31' r='3.4' fill='#42285c'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='31' r='3.4' fill='#42285c'/>
  <circle cx='42' cy='30' r='1.2' fill='#fff6e8'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='30' r='1.2' fill='#fff6e8'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='39' rx='3.6' ry='2.6' fill='#42285c'/>
  <!-- mouth -->
  <path d='M48 42 Q48 46 44 45' stroke='#c0603a' stroke-width='1.6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M48 42 Q48 46 52 45' stroke='#c0603a' stroke-width='1.6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- tongue -->
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='47' rx='2.4' ry='2.6' fill='#ff8a9a'/>
  <!-- music notes -->
  <g fill='#7fd4ff'>
    <circle cx='16' cy='22' r='3'/>
    <rect x='18' y='10' width='2' height='12' fill='#7fd4ff'/>
    <circle cx='82' cy='18' r='2.6'/>
    <rect x='83.6' y='8' width='1.8' height='10'/>
    <circle cx='86' cy='30' r='2.2'/>
    <rect x='87.4' y='22' width='1.6' height='8'/>
  </g>
</svg>
